annotation_method: Manual visual review during development on 2026-10-14; not an independent or held-out benchmark.
coordinate_system: PDF points, x right, y down; bbox [left, top, right, bottom]; page numbers 1-based

evaluation_policy.count_rows: One logical header row and twelve body records. Wrapped labels and stacked header month/year labels stay within their logical cells.
evaluation_policy.content_policy: Geometry only; no document text is transcribed.

ambiguities: Shaded body bands are not column dividers.
Indented row labels are separate records when accompanied by a new line of values.
